Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Rehoboth Beach hotels?

Taxes and fees at Rehoboth Beach hotels

At the 8 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 11% ($14 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 10% at Canalside Inn to 11% at The Bellmoor Inn & Spa. At 5 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
